title: YIELDDISC: a one-row three-way replay on build 20131, and no corpus
upstream_status_verbatim: The row and bead `oxf-pzav` were retired on 2026-07-10.
status_plain: YIELDDISC's row was retired because it was stale: the rate-first formula repair had already landed, the in-crate bit target is pinned, and a fresh three-way replay showed OxFunc, the F-sharp reference and Excel all agreeing. That replay is ONE row. It names its Excel build on the sentence itself, which is unusual in this domain and worth crediting, but a one-row replay is not a corpus figure and YIELDDISC has no count.
